definitions.explanation: The act of decorating a space or object, or the decorations themselves. Used for holiday decorations, party setups, store displays, and general ornamentation.

examples.japanese: クリスマスの{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}けをした。
{子|こ}どもたちと{一緒|いっしょ}に{教室|きょうしつ}の{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}けをした。
examples.english: I decorated the classroom together with the children.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}の{会場|かいじょう}の{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}けは、{花|はな}をたくさん{使|つか}って{華|はな}やかに{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: The wedding venue decorations were finished beautifully with lots of flowers.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun (the decorations or the act of decorating) and as a verb with する. Very common around holidays and events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飾|かざ}り{付|つ}けをする (to decorate)
- クリスマスの{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け (Christmas decorations)
- {部屋|へや}の{飾|かざ}り{付|つ}け (room decoration)
- {飾|かざ}り{付|つ}けを{片付|かたづ}ける (to take down decorations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デコレーション: decoration — the English loanword, used especially for cakes and elaborate designs
- {装飾|そうしょく}: ornamentation — more formal, used in art and architecture
